news.detail: Allgeier wasn't asked to rush much. The No. 2 running back left most of the carries to rookie Jeremiyah Love. The 26-year-old racked up his points on screen passes and checkdowns, catching everything thrown his way for minimal gains.

profile: role: RB2 primary back — 40% of ARI carries, 7% of targets, 62% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
